gaps.sentence: I stand ___ my decision — it was the right one.
gaps.explanation: stand by something = continue to support it; stand by somebody = help and support them.

gaps.sentence: The match kicks ___ at three o'clock.
It took him weeks to get ___ the flu.
gaps.explanation: get over an illness/upset = recover from it.

gaps.sentence: She put her ideas ___ clearly and confidently.
gaps.explanation: put across = communicate an idea successfully.

gaps.sentence: Put ___ your toys when you've finished playing.
gaps.explanation: put away = put something in its usual place.

gaps.sentence: I'll pay you ___ as soon as I get paid.
gaps.explanation: pay somebody back = return borrowed money; pay off a debt = finish paying it.

gaps.sentence: These old boots are completely worn ___.
gaps.explanation: wear out = become thin/unusable through use.

gaps.sentence: Please carry ___ with your work; don't mind me.
gaps.explanation: carry on = continue; carry out = perform (a task).
